name: nespresso-vertuo
grounded_in: Read 2026-08-19. Special Functions chapter lists CLEANING, RESET TO FACTORY SETTINGS and DESCALING. Safety chapter contains the exact sentence 'Replace water in water tank when the appliance is not operated during a weekend or a similar period of time.'
notes: THE trigger case for the whole curation effort: that one safety sentence became an ESSENTIAL recurring task called 'Replace Water in the Tank'. This file exists to make that specific regression impossible to reintroduce unnoticed.

must_have.why: Scale shortens the heater's life; the manual gives descaling its own chapter. If curation ever eats this, the machine has no real task at all.

must_not_have.why: THE regression. A safety note about stale water became an Essential recurring reminder. Refilling a water tank is operating a coffee machine.

Consumable handling is the definition of operation. Narrowed to INSERTING and EJECTING: 'Empty and Rinse Capsule Container' also cleans a part, and the prompt's own rule is to downgrade a borderline step rather than delete it. Forbidding it would have the eval arguing with the prompt.
One-time config / personalisation, explicitly listed under NOT A TASK.
